intro: Browse every obtainable item, its stats, and where to find it — tradable items show their Steam Market price.

filters.watchedOnlyHint: Show only items you've starred for price polling ({{count}} watched)

price.noListingTitle: No active Steam Market listing — open to check the latest
price.approximateTitle: Approximate Steam Market price (converted from USD) — open the listing

notAcquirable: Not obtained through drops, crafting, synthesis, or offerings.

crafting.label: Crafting
crafting.help: Craft this item using the materials under each recipe. Each line is a tier, level band, and slot type; the % is your chance to get this item from that craft.

drop.label: Drop
drop.help: Boss chests that can contain this item. The % is how often it appears in that box's loot table.

synthesis.label: Synthesis
synthesis.help: Combine 9 items at the Cube. Each row is a recipe tier and result level band; the % is your chance to roll this item. Item average level affects which recipes apply. The green left edge marks the best odds among all paths.

offering.sourceHelp: Toss one of the coins below into the Cube for a chance at this item, among everything else in its loot table. The % is your chance of landing this specific item from that coin.
offering.lootHelp: Toss this coin into the Cube to roll one item from its loot table — you'll get exactly one. The % is your chance of getting that specific item.

usedIn.label: Used as ingredient
usedIn.help: Recipes that consume this material as an ingredient. Each block lists what you need and the possible gear from that recipe's loot pool — not recipes that craft this item.

box.whereHelp: Stages where this chest can drop on repeat farming. Drop sources above show kill type and spawn % range. % on each row is per qualifying kill and can differ by stage.
box.firstClearHelp: One-time reward the first time you clear that stage. This chest cannot be farmed from monster or boss kills.
box.noLocation: No known drop locations in the catalog yet.
box.lootHelp: Opening this chest yields exactly one item from its loot table. The % is your chance of getting that specific item.

polling.disabledHint: Enable price polling in Settings to refresh Lookup prices on a schedule.

watched.unwatchTitle: Stop always polling this item's price
